rules.crash10_cash: Move the whole portfolio to SHV on the next session after any allocated component loses at least 10% in one day; re-enter at a monthly check when portfolio wealth is above EMA100.
rules.ema100_cash: At the monthly check, move the whole portfolio to SHV when the portfolio wealth index is below its EMA100; re-enter when it is above EMA100.
